subject: English
title: The Team RAIN
subtitle: Four friends and a rainbow ring
hero_picture: Four Kerala girls holding hands and laughing on a green hill, one with a bicycle, a bright rainbow in the sky.

sections.heading: Meet the team
text: Ritu, Ima, Ami and Nilu are friends.
They walk together. They play together.
points: A for Ami, N for Nilu
sections.caption: Meet the team
sections.picture: Four happy girls holding hands in a green meadow, one with a bicycle.

sections.heading: We love the rain
text: We love playing in the rain.
We love dancing in the rain.
sections.caption: We love the rain
sections.picture: Four girls dancing and splashing happily in the falling rain, one with a small umbrella.

sections.heading: Butterflies and bicycles
text: They chase butterflies. It is fun!
It moves along the roads and over the grass.
sections.caption: Butterflies and bicycles
sections.picture: Girls chasing colourful butterflies near flowers while one rides a bicycle on the grass.

sections.heading: Kites and trees
text: Their kites fly high in the sky.
The Team RAIN likes to climb trees.
'Look, a mango!' 'I can see the hill!'
sections.caption: Kites and trees
sections.picture: Girls sitting on a big mango tree branch, kites flying in the blue sky behind.

sections.heading: The rainbow ring
text: They climb the hill and touch the rainbow.
It is a colourful ring! They swing on it.
SNAP! The pieces fall and turn into flowers.
sections.caption: The rainbow ring
sections.picture: A valley full of colourful flowers under a rainbow, four girls holding hands looking at it.

activity: Draw a rainbow. Colour it with seven colours. Write the names of your friends under it.
talk: Who are in the Team RAIN?
What do they love doing in the rain?
What happened to the pieces of the rainbow?
summary: Ritu, Ima, Ami and Nilu are the Team RAIN; they play together and swing on a rainbow ring.

questions.prompt: Who is NOT in the Team RAIN?
questions.explanation: The team is Ritu, Ima, Ami and Nilu.

questions.prompt: What do the friends love doing in the rain?
questions.explanation: We love dancing in the rain.

questions.prompt: What fruit did they see on the tree?
What shape did the rainbow become?
questions.explanation: The rainbow was round like a ring.
The pieces turned into flowers and filled the valley.
